comment: Pinned upstream of Mesa (docs/40, docs/71, docs/73, docs/research/94): upstream Mesa main at a fixed commit, checked by its tree hash, with this project's KGSL patches (freedreno gallium KGSL backend, KGSL dma-buf sharing, EGL on the KGSL node, Turnip KGSL WSI) in debian/patches/rungic. Until 2026-09-30 the base was the Mesa for Android container branch (lfdevs/mesa-for-android-container 98f3d622); its KGSL parts that this setup needs are carried here, its Termux/PRoot parts are not. Built with meson (plasma/mesa-meson-options, tools/build_mesa.py) and packaged by plasma/package-mesa.py; debian/ holds only the patches and the changelog that names the package version.
